# LHS Library

This directory contains a copy of the lhslib (Latin Hypercube Sampling) library.

**Source**: https://github.com/bertcarnell/lhslib
**Version**: Latest stable as of October 24, 2025 (commit: latest)
**License**: LGPL v3 (see LICENSE file)

## Usage

The library is integrated into the MPPI planner via the `LHSUtility` class in `lex_stl_planner/cpp/utils/lhs_utility.hpp`.
